import type { FunnelProps } from '../schemas' import { Count } from './motion' import { after } from './theatre' import { cx, pct } from './util' const ROW = 48 /** * How many make it through each step, drawn as a funnel. Each step is a band as wide as its count, and the band narrows * into the next step, so the drop shows as a shape as well as a number. The share kept at each step is computed here. */ export function Funnel({ title, unit, steps, className }: FunnelProps & { className?: string }) { const first = steps[0]?.value ?? 0 const last = steps[steps.length - 1]?.value ?? 0 const share = (v: number) => (first > 0 ? v / first : 0) return (

{title}

{pct(share(last), 0)} reach the end
    {steps.map((step, i) => { const prev = steps[i - 1]?.value const kept = prev && prev > 0 ? step.value / prev : null const top = Math.max(share(step.value), 0.06) * 100 const next = steps[i + 1]?.value const bottom = next !== undefined ? Math.max(Math.min(share(next), share(step.value)), 0.06) * 100 : top * 0.72 const tone = `color-mix(in srgb, var(--ol-accent) ${Math.max(35, 100 - i * 18)}%, var(--ol-bg))` const label = `${step.label}: ${step.value} ${unit}${kept !== null ? `, ${pct(kept, 0)} kept from the step before` : ''}` return (
  1. {step.label} {unit} {kept !== null && kept}
    2. ) })}
) }
